data.tagline: Enterprise Field Operations & Remote Team Dispatching HTML5 Web Template
data.author: Pixoptimo Labs
data.techStack: HTML5 Semantic, Vanilla CSS3, Custom Properties, Zero Runtime, Responsive Grid
data.browserSupport: All Modern Browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge)
data.overview:
PREFIOP Free is an enterprise-grade field operations and mobile team dispatching SaaS template built for field service management platforms, logistics startups, and remote operational teams.

Designed from the ground up with fluid typography, responsive layout containers, and zero-framework runtime overhead, PREFIOP achieves lightning-fast load times while maintaining high-end visual elegance. It includes ready-to-use landing sections for live dispatch metrics, GPS routing showcases, and technician fleet telemetry.
data.features:
Real-time dispatch telemetry and fleet status showcase cards
Responsive mobile-first grid with fluid CSS clamp() scaling
Accessible WCAG 2.1 AAA color contrast compliance
Zero-framework dependencies — 100% vanilla HTML5 and CSS3
Modular component hierarchy for effortless customization
data.fileStructure:
prefiop-free.html // Core landing page markup
assets/ // Static stylesheets and resources
  css/style.css // Design tokens, layout & typography
  js/app.js // Vanilla interactions and navigation
  images/ // High-resolution template previews
README.md // Setup guidelines and quick-start instructions
data.quickStartCode:
<!-- Plug & play PREFIOP template into any web host -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/style.css">
<script src="assets/js/app.js" defer></script>
